records.question: What is the total revenue?
records.agent_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM sales LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many unique customers are there?
records.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS unique_customers FROM sales WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL LIMIT 1000

records.question: What are the top 5 countries by revenue, excluding the United Kingdom?
records.agent_sql: SELECT country, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM sales WHERE country <> 'United Kingdom' GROUP BY country ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: Which month had the highest revenue?
records.agent_sql: SELECT STRFTIME(invoice_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM sales GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: What are the top 10 products by units sold? Use stock code.
records.agent_sql: SELECT stock_code, MAX(description) AS description, SUM(quantity) AS units_sold FROM sales GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 10

records.question: What is the average order value?
records.agent_sql: WITH order_revenue AS (SELECT invoice, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales GROUP BY invoice) SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_revenue), 2) AS average_order_value FROM order_revenue LIMIT 1000

records.question: What percentage of all invoices were cancelled?
records.agent_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_cancelled THEN invoice END) / COUNT(DISTINCT invoice), 2) AS cancellation_percentage FROM transactions LIMIT 1000

records.question: What percentage of revenue comes from the top 10% of customers?
records.agent_sql: WITH customer_revenue AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY customer_id), ranked_customers AS (SELECT total_revenue, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS p_rank FROM customer_revenue), summary AS (SELECT SUM(total_revenue) AS grand_total, SUM(CASE WHEN p_rank <= 0.10 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS top_10_total FROM ranked_customers) SELECT ROUND((top_10_total * 100.0) / grand_total, 2) AS percentage_revenue FROM summary LIMIT 1000

records.question: What percentage of customers placed more than one order?
records.agent_sql: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) AS order_count FROM sales WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY customer_id), customer_summary AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_order_customers FROM customer_orders) SELECT ROUND(CAST(multi_order_customers AS DOUBLE) * 100.0 / total_customers, 2) AS percentage FROM customer_summary LIMIT 1000

records.question: By what percentage did revenue change from November 2010 to December 2010?
records.agent_sql: WITH monthly_revenue AS (SELECT STRFTIME(invoice_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales GROUP BY STRFTIME(invoice_date, '%Y-%m')), with_lag AS (SELECT month, total_revenue, LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue FROM monthly_revenue) SELECT ROUND(((total_revenue - prev_revenue) / prev_revenue) * 100, 2) AS percentage_change FROM with_lag WHERE month = '2010-12' LIMIT 1000
